description: This file 'HdmiCecSink.cpp' implements a plugin module for handling HDMI CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) functionalities. It manages HDMI input, CEC message processing, device control commands, and event notifications within a larger media or TV system. The code includes C++ class definitions, namespace encapsulation, thread management, event handling, and integration with system services through IARM (Inter-Application Resource Manager). It supports features like device discovery, power management, routing control, and remote key event forwarding.
